notes.title: Patch Notes and Soundtrack (v2.03)
notes.content:
[b]Patch notes for v2.03[/b]

Hint flames should now all be behaving correctly. 

The Continue Game button on the title menu should now select the most recent overall save and not just the most recent auto-save.

Bug for dragon leg hotspots at cave door entrance remaining active is fixed.

Quit game from the pause menu in-game will now take you to the title screen & not completely quit the program at that point.

Firestarter, parrot & glow picture achievements will attempt to resend at the title menu if there was a connection error when sending the first time.

Improved load times in some areas.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

Additionally, if you'd like to check out the soundtrack for the game, you can pick it up on Bandcamp, listen on Spotify, or find it on iTunes!

Bandcamp - https://nathancleary.bandcamp.com/album/chook-sosig-walk-the-plank-ost
iTunes - https://music.apple.com/jp/album/chook-sosig-walk-the-plank-original-game-soundtrack/1467115926?l=en
Spotify - https://open.spotify.com/album/5kcXIVpSDq550YxcIoSwLV?si=1A8r2dJqRk2xiUGLs7EgQA



Have a very lovely day and a very happy 4th of July tomorrow for those who celebrate it.

-Sarah/Tooki

notes.content:

The game is now live and roaming free like a naughty wild thing.
It's been a really fun year or so and I've learned heaps and grown a lot. I can't thank Armor Games Studios enough for giving me the opportunity to focus on creating this & for the huge level of support I've received from friendly faces checking in and cheering, it's been really heartwarming and a fantastic experience.

I hope everyone enjoys it!

This is start of a fantastic journey & I cannot wait to get stuck onto new and exciting new roads using all the things I've learned.
I'm going to be dangerous >:}

notes.title: Alright April
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/dbef05cdcbac23eeb6c80c054de3d19255e6ea42.png[/img]




[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

This past month has been all hands on deck (I wish I had more than two) it's tiring, but really satisfying!

This months entry is going to be a fairly quick read as most of the months work has been a lot of dialog/spoilery and non-visual things.

I do have some news to share though!

I received some questions about the process of creating a game and what I've learned this past year, I popped them up in a post on [url=https://imgur.com/gallery/M3I6Cf9]Imgur here.[/url]

 Walk the Plank will also be available on release via itch.io!
This in particular makes me really really happy as it was such a huge help to me, and also the ease with which you can access and distribute games.  The small team at itch are hugely passionate about what they do and it shows.

The page is looking really pretty, have a gander at it here if you like!
[url=https://armor-games-studios.itch.io/chook-sosig-walk-the-plank]Itch.io page[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

I know what we can do, I can share some of the really lovely things I've been sent!

It's hard to describe how moving it is that someone might dedicate any portion of time to creating something inspired by these characters and their world. I've never had anything like that happen before. It sends me into a wild glee and I do the rounds shoving it under everyone's nose who I come into contact with, to croon over it with me. It's also delicious how much personal flair everyone puts on them because they are all fairly simple characters. 
(I could keep on gushing, I'll put a cork in it here.)
 

I'll include a couple each month because I want to celebrate and share these fine folks work.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/e5eb580a28a2f104777276f9d10bcb67f480eb77.jpg[/img]

by [url=https://twitter.com/Sitaart]Sita Art[/url]


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/02ff70ad5d71c85307f7965647c84c35be34fe2f.jpg[/img]

By [url=https://twitter.com/GrimdorkDesign]Grimdork Design[/url]




If you would like to keep a closer eye on what I'm up to you can keep a watchful eye on me over at my twitter which can be found [url=https://twitter.com/TookiPalooki]here.[/url]

Also, if you haven't already please do take a moment to wish list the game as it helps a tremendous amount.
 

I look forward to chatting again next month, please stay safe and speak very soon!

Cheers

   -Sarah[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/7718ffdaaaccd6a64ef85c7e33baf8a50a4ce2f3.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/3811f64ac29f768f38492ad88f8d5819c0b0fbf1.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Merry March!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/dbef05cdcbac23eeb6c80c054de3d19255e6ea42.png[/img]


Hello! I hope everyone is keeping well and that your beginnings to the year so far have been mighty!


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]



Something very exciting I got to do this past month for the first time were some audio interviews. I did my first live with Joy FM for the show Checkpoint, where Luke & the team there were so warm and welcoming that my nerves vanished pretty quickly. I was more concerned that my connection would suddenly blip out that anything else by the end, They were such a bubbly team of people to talk to.

If you would like to listen to me discussing cozy gaming with the Checkpoint team it can be listened to via the following link: 
[url=Snuggle in With Cozy Gaming]Snuggle in With Cozy Gaming[/url]

I also had the pleasure of talking to lovely Paul James for the Dev Diary podcast, where we chatted about my journey so far into gamedev and what makes me tick creatively.
[url=https://www.player2.net.au/2019/02/dev-diary-8-sarah-asquith-tooki-palooki/]Dev Diaries [/url]


I've brought along some more screenshots to show you too!
The first one is Hebble's Adventurer's guild clubhouse where I can slap plenty of cartoon animal heads on the wall and decorate with animal based furniture. I'm fond of the dodo plant pot, it looks less impressed though.

Secondly are my horrible goblin children, super enthusiastic but heavily destructive and act on impulse. They say pretty much exactly whats on their minds and aren't afraid or even aware of offending anyone. They are like wild kids.

Lastly is the tavern, Hebble has been on his break for about a week. Cow's not really very clued in on workplace law, so Hebble's just creating the ideal environment for himself, one where he pretty much does nothing.
He's over the moon about this.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/b71343aab9a4b47dba66028238d17e3a3c81b3e7.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/14cdc5c710a511212d16a409addd4700b47e95ce.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/d352194d6740136004df0920591bbd63af5de450.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

On the music front Nathan has been hard at work creating music for the last few scenes. It's wonderful how much life they give to each location. 
Listen to how lively and cheerful this track is, his work always brings a smile to my face!

[url=https://soundcloud.com/nathan-cleary-123/chook-sosi-ost-strollin-the-boardwalk?in=nathan-cleary-123/sets/chook-sosig-walk-the-plank-ost]Strollin' The Boardwalk[/url]

 If you would like to keep a closer eye on what I'm up to you can keep a watchful eye on me over at my twitter which can be found [url=https://twitter.com/TookiPalooki]here.[/url]

You can also have these posts delivered direct to your inbox by [url=https://tookipalooki.us12.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=55cfb405656f5154c26f464ba&id=070eb812fc]joining the newsletter[/url] if you like.

Speak to you soon!
 
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/fa656da4877324627ccd501eeb81f8dca0d8c608.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/a3aa6aa855c70a0ba2dc5679988533913a7b0598.png[/img][/url]

-Tooki

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/dbef05cdcbac23eeb6c80c054de3d19255e6ea42.png[/img]
                                         [b]A Very Happy New Year![/b]
                                            Hello and welcome to 2019.
                                            Let's hope it'll be a good one!


It's so exciting to think I'll be releasing a game this year on Steam, it's been wild now having a real page, with a trailer and everything. It makes me all emotional that I can make something from my little corner of the world and share it with others so far away. If you are interested do take the time to wishlist as it means a great deal.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

The locations showcased in the screenshots below are firstly of Cow's shop where he can live his dream of owning a general store which sells nothing of importance & has no intention of making money. For anyone who has been working retail over this holiday season you are a champ. Cow has managed to offload all his complaints onto a pet goldfish who will deal with them in due course.

Hebble on the other hand has one goal in mind when playing and it's how to be the focus of every scene and ham up every role he can. He's an attention seeking gremlin but he's harmless. He's incredibly happy being a mermaid because that'll mean he's hot and that means even more eyes on him. It's a horrible cycle of Hebble looking for compliments to feed his ego.

Finally Min role-plays like that mild mannered relative who when playing Monopoly becomes a frothing cut-throat tyrant. She loves all the strong and moody characters and so is brooding away on her little private island with a hefty battleaxe close at hand. >:}

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/82b85f7eb0dea0fc248c753a01728fb12602c5a7.png[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/51a7847a430619b26a01ced370ff00c734178cac.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/a91ffa5a0c68b633dc86d98c9d7ccf0403e403d6.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34009046/c8b1a02f65d332075456974d553979aa527ac6dd.png[/img]

 If you would like to keep a closer eye on what I'm up to you can keep a watchful eye on me over at my twitter which can be found [url=https://twitter.com/TookiPalooki]Here.[/url]

These posts can also be recieved via email via the mailing list: [url=https://tookipalooki.us12.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=55cfb405656f5154c26f464ba&id=070eb812fc]Mailing List[/url] 

Until we next meet!

I hope you have a fantastic start to the new year and I'll speak to you soon!

-Tooki

This is exciting, welcome to the Steam page for Chook & Sosig: Walk the Plank!

Thank-you so much for popping by and checking it out & if this looks like your kind of thing, please do remember to wishlist.

The support over the last couple of years has been really warm and lovely and keeps my light burning as I work in my goblin cave. I can't thank folk enough for it. 

I'll be updating here hand-in-hand with the current mailing list, which if you are intrigued can be signed up for here: [url=https://tookipalooki.us12.list-manage.com/subscribe?u=55cfb405656f5154c26f464ba&id=070eb812fc]Mailing List[/url]

                     -Tooki
